WITH ema AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%ema summary of product characteristics%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%retacrit%'
),
fda AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%fda%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%epoetin alfa%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%biosimilar%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%anemia%'
)
SELECT e.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT s.synonym
          FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
          WHERE s.drugbank_id = e.parent_key
            AND lower(s.language) LIKE '%english%'
          ORDER BY CASE lower(s.coder)
                     WHEN 'inn/usan' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'inn' THEN 2
                     WHEN 'usan' THEN 3
                     ELSE 4
                   END,
                   length(s.synonym)
          LIMIT 1
         ),
         (SELECT s.synonym
          FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
          WHERE s.drugbank_id = e.parent_key
          ORDER BY length(s.synonym)
          LIMIT 1
         )
       ) AS preferred_name
FROM ema e
JOIN fda f ON f.parent_key = e.parent_key

  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS drug_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
